about: The characters a result name may not hold (docs/named-result-sets-scope.md, Syntax): C0 and C1 controls, line and paragraph separators, bidirectional marks, embeddings, overrides and isolates, and the BOM, as inclusive UTF-16 code unit ranges. The backend's ResultNames.IsRefused (ResultNameChecks.cs) and the descriptor schema's refusedResultNameChars (tests/result-name-descriptor.test.ts) are each checked against every code unit here. The marker scan collapses a tab with other white space instead of refusing it, so no name it produces holds one.
